Name: Arlouria's Spring Cottagecore Tools Recolor
Author: OhheyyHannahh
Description:
Arlouria's Spring cottagecore Tools Recolor changes the basic tool set given at the start of the game to a floral spring design, along with a grassy look. The hoe, axe, pickaxe, watering can will be changed, along with the milk pail & shears. At the moment, this mod is only the basic tools, the other tools will be added as the mod progresses.

UPDATE: Mod has been updated to include copper, steel, gold & iridium! i will be working on including galaxy weapons, plus the scythe. Thank you for your patience.

1.6 Update: ----> Cleaned up the tools visuals, made them cleaner looking with less "grass" texture.

If you enjoy my mods, consider [url=http://ko-fi.com/arlouria]buying me a coffee[/url] :)
